001: Hey Lucas, you look tired today. Are you okay?
Not really, I've had a headache since this morning.
Oh, did you take something for it?
Yes, a tablet, but it hasn't kicked in yet.
Get some rest, then. You should drink some water.
You're right, I'm going to lie down for a bit.
002: Hello doctor, I haven't been feeling well since yesterday.
Hello Camille. What exactly is hurting you?
I have a sore throat and I'm coughing a lot.
Do you have a fever? Let me check.
I don't know, I haven't taken my temperature.
We'll see about that. Open your mouth, please.
003: Hugo, you look pale. Are you sick?
I've had a stomach ache since lunch, it's weird.
Maybe, I had a salad at the restaurant.
You should drink some mint tea, it helps.
Good idea, I'll try that. Thanks.
004: Hello, Manon? I can't come to class today.
Oh, what's going on? Are you sick?
Yes, I have a fever and I'm very tired.
Have you seen a doctor? You should go.
Not yet, I'm going to call to make an appointment.
Get some rest and keep me posted.
005: Ouch, I twisted my ankle while running.
Oh no, does it hurt? Can you walk?
A little, but it's painful when I put weight on it.
You need to put ice on it right away.
You're right, and I'll elevate it.
If it doesn't get better, go see a doctor.
006: Hello, I'd like something for a cold.
Of course. Is your nose stuffy or runny?
Both, and I'm sneezing all the time.
Okay, this nasal spray should help you.
Thanks. How many times a day do I take it?
Twice a day, morning and evening, for a week.
007: Yes, I'm doing much better, thanks!
Is your throat no longer sore?
No, it's over. I slept well and had some honey.
That's great! Honey is great for the throat.
I can confirm, it really worked well.
008: Thomas, you sound funny. Do you have a cold?
Yes, I caught a chill this weekend.
Did you cough all night? You look exhausted.
A little, but I took some cough syrup.
You should also rest and drink something hot.
Yes, I'm going to make myself some herbal tea tonight.
009: I'm allergic to pollen, it's terrible right now.
Oh, I see. Are your eyes itchy?
Yes, and I can't stop sneezing.
Yes, but it makes me a bit sleepy.
That's normal. Try to stay home if you can.
010: Doctor, I've had an earache for two days.
Let me take a look. Does it hurt when you swallow?
Yes, a little, and I can't hear as well out of that ear.
It's a minor infection. I'm going to prescribe some drops.
Okay, how long do I use them for?
For five days, three times a day. Come back if it doesn't get better.
